title: Uruguayan Red Onion Relish
description: A simple, flavorful relish made with Uruguayan red onions, gluten-free and perfect for serving alongside grilled meats.
instructions: Thinly slice the Uruguayan red onion and place it in a bowl.
Add the sliced red onion to the bowl with the Uruguayan red onion and mix to combine.
Add 2 tsp of jubilant to the bowl and mix until the onions are evenly coated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the relish chilled or at room temperature.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
